US.instrument: National Aeronautics and Space Act (1958) + Commercial Space Launch Act (1984, as amended) with FCC/NOAA licensing regulations

CIS.instrument: Law of the Russian Federation on Space Activity, Federal Law No. 5663-1

PRC.instrument: Measures for the Administration of the Registration of Objects Launched into Outer Space (2001); no comprehensive licensing act, registration/administrative regime only

UK.instrument: Outer Space Act 1986 (superseded in part by Space Industry Act 2018)

JPN.instrument: Act on Launching of Spacecraft, etc. and Control of Spacecraft (Space Activities Act, Act No. 76 of 2016), implementing the Basic Space Act 2008

IND.instrument: No comprehensive space act in force; Indian Space Policy 2023 and IN-SPACe are non-statutory; Space Activities Bill 2017 lapsed in 2019, new draft bill in progress as of 2025

ITSO.instrument: Commercial successor Intelsat S.A. is incorporated in Luxembourg; historic ITSO is an intergovernmental treaty organisation with no single supervising national law

ESA.instrument: Intergovernmental organisation established by the ESA Convention (1975); no single national supervising law

IT.instrument: Law No. 23/1983 (Ratsiel/liability implementation) and Law No. 7/2018 reorganising ASI and space governance coordination

GER.instrument: Satellite Data Security Act (SatDSiG) 2007; note: Germany lacks a comprehensive launch-licensing space act — a draft German Space Act was still in development as of 2025, this entry reflects the narrower data-security law UNOOSA lists as principal instrument

GLOB.instrument: US-incorporated (Delaware) commercial operator, licensed by the FCC

CA.instrument: Canadian Space Agency Act (1990), plus Remote Sensing Space Systems Act (2005) and Radiocommunication Act licensing regime

SES.instrument: SES S.A., HQ Betzdorf, Luxembourg; supervised under Luxembourg's Law of 15 December 2020 on Space Activities (also FCC-regulated for US operations)

SKOR.instrument: Space Development Promotion Act (Act No. 7538, 2005) and Space Damage Compensation Act (2007)

EUTE.instrument: Eutelsat Communications S.A., HQ Issy-les-Moulineaux, France; regulated by ARCEP under French Space Operations Act

SPN.instrument: Royal Decree 278/1995 establishes a satellite registry only; no comprehensive space-activities licensing law in force as of 2026

TURK.instrument: Presidential Decree No. 658 establishing the Turkish Space Agency (2018); no comprehensive space-activities licensing law enacted as of 2026

ARGN.instrument: National Decree No. 995/91 creating CONAE (Comisión Nacional de Actividades Espaciales), ratified by Law No. 24061

O3B.instrument: Wholly owned subsidiary of SES, HQ Betzdorf, Luxembourg

NOR.instrument: Act No. 38 on Launching Objects from Norwegian Territory etc. into Outer Space

ISRA.instrument: No domestic space legislation enacted; regulation relies on general law; drafting reported as of 2021

BRAZ.instrument: Law No. 8.854/1994 (AEB creation) plus Administrative Edict/Resolution 51/2001 on commercial launch licensing regime

UAE.instrument: Federal Law No. 12 of 2019 on the Regulation of the Space Sector, superseded by Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2023

INDO.instrument: Law No. 21 of 2013 on Space Activities

IM.instrument: HQ London, UK; regulated under UK Wireless Telegraphy regulations / Ofcom

SING.instrument: No overarching space legislation; only non-binding guidelines (2024); National Space Agency planned for April 2026

AB.instrument: Intergovernmental Arab organisation; HQ Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; no single supervising national law

GREC.instrument: Law 4508/2017 on Authorisation of Space Activities and Establishment of a Greek Space Organisation, amended by Law 4712/2020

SAUD.instrument: Space Law, implemented by the Communications, Space & Technology Commission (CST)

EGYP.instrument: Law No. 3 of 2018 establishes the Egyptian Space Agency (agency-creation statute); no comprehensive licensing/authorisation regime for private space activities

POL.instrument: Act of 26 September 2014 creating the Polish Space Agency (POLSA); no comprehensive space-activities licensing act enacted

EUME.instrument: European intergovernmental meteorological satellite organisation, HQ Darmstadt, Germany; no single supervising state

THAI.instrument: Draft National Space Act pending Council of State review as of 2024; not yet enacted

LUXE.instrument: Law of 15 December 2020 on Space Activities

PAKI.instrument: Pakistan Space Activities Rules 2024 (under National Command Authority Act 2010), establishing the Pakistan Space Activities Regulatory Board (PSARB)

IRAN.instrument: No comprehensive space act; only Iranian Space Agency statute governing the agency itself

MEX.instrument: Ley que Crea la Agencia Espacial Mexicana (2010) establishes the Mexican Space Agency; no comprehensive private-activity licensing law identified

BEL.instrument: Law on the Activities of Launching, Flight Operations or Guidance of Space Objects

NATO.instrument: Intergovernmental military alliance; no single supervising national space law

AC.instrument: Hong Kong-incorporated, licensed under Hong Kong's Outer Space Ordinance

ABS.instrument: Bermuda-incorporated (ABS Global Ltd.), HQ Hamilton, Bermuda (UK Overseas Territory)

SWTZ.instrument: Draft Federal Act on Space Operations submitted to Parliament 25 Feb 2026; not yet enacted

NETH.instrument: Rules Concerning Space Activities and the Establishment of a Registry of Space Objects (Space Activities Act)

RWA.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified; Rwanda Space Agency established by law but authorisation/licensing regime not confirmed

CZCH.instrument: No space legislation enacted as of late 2024; draft law stalled

UKR.instrument: Law of Ukraine on Space Activity No. 503/96-VR

CHBZ.instrument: Joint CBERS programme; dual-owner SATCAT code, reported under China's registration regime (see PRC) and Brazil's AEB regime (see BRAZ)

NIG.instrument: National Space Research and Development Agency Act (NASRDA Act)

BUL.instrument: No national space activities law identified; "Spatial Development Act" found in research is a land-use/construction law, unrelated to space activities

BELA.instrument: Presidential Decree No. 609 (2004) is a policy/coordination decree, not a licensing law

MA.instrument: SATCAT owner code MA; no comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

HUN.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

RP.instrument: Republic Act No. 11363, Philippine Space Act

CHLE.instrument: Supreme Decree No. 338 establishes an advisory space committee only; no comprehensive licensing law

VENZ.instrument: Ley de la Agencia Bolivariana para Actividades Espaciales (ABAE)

FGER.instrument: Dual-owner SATCAT code; both France (Space Operations Act 2008, see FR) and Germany (SatDSiG 2007, see GER) have relevant instruments; treated as unknown at the code level

STCT.instrument: Dual-owner SATCAT code; Taiwan has a Space Development Act (2021, see ROC) while Singapore has no space law (see SING); treated as unknown at the code level

RASC.instrument: Registered in Mauritius; operational HQ in Dubai, UAE

ECU.instrument: Executive Decree No. 1246 (2012) creates the Ecuadorian Civilian Space Agency (agency-creation only); no comprehensive licensing law

PERU.instrument: Decree-Law No. 20643 (1974) creates CONIDA (agency-creation only); no comprehensive licensing law

FRIT.instrument: Dual-owner SATCAT code; both France (Space Operations Act 2008, see FR) and Italy (Law 23/1983 and Law 7/2018, see IT) have relevant instruments; treated as unknown at the code level

ANG.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

LTU.instrument: No dedicated national space activities law identified; only territorial/spatial planning legislation found

KWT.instrument: No national space activities law identified; Law No. 37 of 2014 establishes CITRA (general telecom regulator), not a space-specific law

ISS.instrument: Governed by the 1998 Intergovernmental Agreement (IGA) among ISS partner states (US, Russia, Japan, Canada, ESA member states); not a single national law

USBZ.instrument: Dual-owner SATCAT code; both US (see US) and Brazil (see BRAZ) have relevant instruments; treated as unknown at the code level

COL.instrument: Decree 2442 (2006) creates the Colombian Space Commission (agency-creation only); no comprehensive licensing law

EST.instrument: Draft Space Act sent for approval by Ministry of Economy and Communications in September 2024; not yet enacted as of mid-2026

BOL.instrument: No comprehensive national space activities law identified; Bolivian Space Agency (ABE) created administratively

URY.instrument: No comprehensive national space activities law identified

IRAQ.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

TMMC.instrument: Dual-owner SATCAT code; neither Turkmenistan nor Monaco confirmed to have a comprehensive national space law; treated as unknown at the code level

LAOS.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

BGD.instrument: No dedicated national space act; satellite licensing handled under the Bangladesh Telecommunication Act 2001 via BTRC; has acceded only to the Outer Space Treaty

JOR.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

GRSA.instrument: Dual-owner SATCAT code; both Greece (Law 4508/2017, see GREC) and Saudi Arabia (Space Law, see SAUD) have relevant instruments; treated as unknown at the code level

ETH.instrument: Proclamation No. 1263/2021 and Regulation No. 511/2022 establish the Space Science and Geospatial Institute (SSGI) (agency-creation only); no comprehensive licensing regime for private space activities identified

NKOR.instrument: Law on Space Development, adopted by the Supreme People's Assembly, amended 2022 to permit defence use

HRV.instrument: No dedicated national space activities law identified; only unrelated spatial/land-planning legislation found

DJI.instrument: Décret N°2023-209 and Loi relative aux activités de lancement et d'exploitation d'objets spatiaux

BWA.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

BHR.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

SLB.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

NZ.instrument: Outer Space and High-Altitude Activities Act 2017

MNE.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources

ROM.instrument: No comprehensive national space law identified in available sources; Romania has a national space agency (ROSA) established administratively
